code.text: CHEM
COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin). There is also mild hypocalcemia, hyperchloremia, and abnormal coagulation (elevated INR, low PT). These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible infection, and risk for coagulopathy. Clinical correlation and further evaluation for underlying causes (e.g., severe infection, sepsis, or hematologic disorder) are recommended.
